# opnsense_mdnsrepeater_settings (Data Source)

Reads mDNS Repeater settings. Requires the `os-mdns-repeater` plugin.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opnsense_mdnsrepeater_settings" "settings" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `blocklist` (Set of String) Client IPv4 addresses or networks excluded from repeating.
- `enable_carp` (Boolean) Whether the repeater service only runs on the CARP master.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the repeater is enabled.
- `id` (String) Always set to `mdnsrepeater_settings`.
- `interfaces` (Set of String) Listen interfaces.
